content.text: The most common violation in 2021 was speeding. Now I will calculate the percentage of all accidents that were caused by speeding in 2021 and 2011, and then calculate the difference.

args.sql:
WITH
  yearly_counts AS (
    SELECT
      EXTRACT(YEAR FROM strptime(collision_date, '%Y-%m-%d')::DATE) AS collision_year,
      pcf_violation_category,
      COUNT(case_id) AS collision_count
    FROM california_traffic_collision.main.collisions
    WHERE
      EXTRACT(YEAR FROM strptime(collision_date, '%Y-%m-%d')::DATE) IN (2011, 2021)
    GROUP BY
      1,
      2
  ),
  total_counts AS (
    SELECT
      collision_year,
      SUM(collision_count) AS total_collisions
    FROM yearly_counts
    GROUP BY
      1
  ),
  speeding_counts AS (
    SELECT
      collision_year,
      collision_count AS speeding_collisions
    FROM yearly_counts
    WHERE
      pcf_violation_category = 'speeding'
  )
SELECT
  s_2021.speeding_collisions / t_2021.total_collisions * 100 AS percentage_2021,
  s_2011.speeding_collisions / t_2011.total_collisions * 100 AS percentage_2011,
  (s_2021.speeding_collisions / t_2021.total_collisions * 100) - (s_2011.speeding_collisions / t_2011.total_collisions * 100) AS percentage_point_difference
FROM speeding_counts AS s_2011
JOIN total_counts AS t_2011
  ON s_2011.collision_year = t_2011.collision_year
JOIN speeding_counts AS s_2021
  ON s_2021.collision_year = 2021
JOIN total_counts AS t_2021
  ON t_2021.collision_year = 2021
WHERE
  s_2011.collision_year = 2011;
